intent: Add sensitivity, drivers, goal seek, positional variance, explicit check packs, and a session evidence notebook/brief using saved workbook revisions and shared privacy guards.

requirements_completeness.assessment: The plan supplies six capability goals and verification boundaries, with no formal requirement or implementation-unit IDs. The reviewed changes cover the six capabilities; no missing explicit requirement remains.

learnings.title: Keep privacy headers aligned with protected values
learnings.note: Shared privacy checks precede financial derivatives; preserve header provenance.

learnings.title: Bounded checks are prefixes
learnings.note: The model boundary refuses truncated input rather than certifying unseen cells.

learnings.title: Separate saved values from recalculation
learnings.note: Variance and checks use saved bytes; scenario calculations use the engine.

learnings.title: Engine completion is not independent value verification
learnings.note: Retain disposable child-process limits and source-revision checks.

learnings.title: Validate across workbook genres
learnings.note: Before claiming wider applicability, extend evidence beyond compact model examples to dataset-shaped workbooks.

residual_risks: DecisionResults asserts a broad optional-field type at the HTTP boundary; action/result drift is not compile-time checked. No current mismatch was demonstrated.
testing_gaps: Upper supported workload latency (5x5 sensitivity or near-40-iteration goal seek on a 10,000-cell/2,000-formula model) was not measured; the 30-second timeout remains a documented refusal boundary.

coverage.standards: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md instruction fallback; all changed paths.

results.reason: Concurrent repair now renders comparison and effective tolerance in src/DecisionDesk.tsx:65, with labels defined in src/evidence-brief.ts:10. Validator and report leaf inspected these lines; browser incidence was not measured by the validator.
